title: Gold Ring
html:
A Gold Ring is a common type of Ring. Primarily of use for barter or sale to Traders.

A date was once engraved on the inside of this ring, but most of it has long since been worn away by time.

Properties

  •  Rings
  •  Rarity: Common
  •  Weight: 0.05 kg (0.1 lb)
  •  Price: 20 gp
